description: This file defines the RowDimension class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing the properties and behaviors of a worksheet row, such as height and index.

classes.name: RowDimension
classes.description: Represents the dimensions and properties of a worksheet row, including height and index.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new RowDimension object with an optional row index.

methods.name: getRowIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the row.

methods.name: setRowIndex
methods.description: Sets the index of the row.

methods.name: getRowHeight
methods.description: Retrieves the height of the row, optionally converting to a specified unit of measure.

methods.name: setRowHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the row, accepting optional unit of measure for conversion.

methods.name: getZeroHeight
methods.description: Returns whether the row has zero height.

methods.name: setZeroHeight
methods.description: Sets whether the row has zero height.
